task.title: A detached create loses its outcome and its draft silently
task.description:
The create branch of the detail submit catch still returns silently when the reader navigates away while a slow create is in flight and it then fails: the drafted task's refusal is reported nowhere and the typed draft is gone. PR #73 fixed exactly this for detached saves (reportDetachedSaveFailure) and deliberately scoped creates out; its review confirmed the gap.

Unlike the save path, recovery machinery already exists for creates: reportRefusedCreation and reportRecoverableDraft can hand a refused draft back. Wire the detached branch into them so a detached create's failure is reported (notice + staged, matching the save path's shape) and the draft is recoverable rather than lost.

Acceptance: a create that fails while detached reports its outcome where the reader will see it and offers the draft back; a create that lands while detached does not hijack the route (matching PR #73's landed-save behavior); red-green tests mirroring internal/webui/detail_detached_save_test.go's held-request idiom.
